Hi John — thanks for the questions and the timeline. Short answers up front, details below.

1) Migration surcharge: this is a one-time professional-services line covering engineering hours to bundle and validate the private deployment (VPC peering, KMS integration, image hardening, runbook handover). Typical range for an engagement of NovaMed's size (5 clusters, hybrid on-prem edge) is $85k–$140k depending on testing scope.

2) Proration: we can offer a 60% waiver on the surcharge if NovaMed signs a 12-month committed Dedicated capacity + Private deployment agreement by the end of Q2 and confirms the Q4 rollout window. Alternatively, a scaled waiver: 30% if you commit to a 6-month pilot conversion by Q3.

3) Enterprise SRE Tier: summary — 24/7 on-call rotation, 1-hour P1 response, targeted 99.9% uptime for model endpoints, monthly operations reviews, quarterly architecture reviews. We can itemize an addendum that maps response times to runbook steps.

Attached: SOW-draft-v2.pdf (high level) and migration-costs.xlsx (hourly assumptions).

Proposed next step: if this is acceptable, Marissa will prepare a redline-friendly term sheet with the conditional waiver language and anchor the deal to the NM-2026-042 record.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Soojin / Grace — looping in Irene (legal) because NovaMed is pushing for the surcharge to be removed entirely. Quick notes from my side:

- Baseline migration surcharge estimate: $112,500 (see sheet). Breaks down to engineering (75%), security validation (15%), travel & incidental (10%).
- Commercial concession proposal: 60% waiver on the surcharge in exchange for: 12-month committed private deployment + 2.5M token/month minimum for the Dedicated capacity; revenue recognition terms standard (monthly). We should also require a 90-day clawback if they cancel before conversion.
- If legal won't accept clawback language, alternative is to keep 40% waiver and add a 6-month pilot-to-commit milestone with smaller conversion credit.

Questions for you both: 1) do we want to make the 60% waiver contingent on signature only (tight), or signature + payment milestones? 2) product needs to confirm SRE SLA scope that matches our support catalog — Grace, can you confirm SRE SKU and recurring cost so we can show impact to ARR?

Irene — can you flag any legal redlines we should avoid (especially around refunds / proof of deployment)?

Thanks,

Appreciate the breakdown. A few operational clarifications so finance can model:

- Enterprise SRE Tier SKU: $18,000/month (covers up to 3 production endpoints and standard on-call rotations). For NovaMed's scale we should add a 'multisite add-on' +$6,500/mo.
- If we do the 60% waiver (i.e., reduce $112.5k to $45k out-of-pocket), projected ARR uplift over 12 months assuming 2.5M tokens/mo is $1.1M net. The clawback helps protect us but tends to be negotiable.
- Product confirms there are one-time engineering tasks that cannot be fully avoided (KMS, encryption-at-rest validation, and CVE hardening) — I recommend keeping at least a $30k fixed migration baseline in any path we accept.

Recommendation: propose to NovaMed the 60% waiver but with two firm conditions: 1) 12-month commit at the stated capacity; 2) a 90-day clawback (or prorated refund schedule). If legal pushes back, default to 40% waiver + $30k minimum.

If you want, Soojin, I can draft the commercial language and Irene can pre-check legal's acceptability.

Grace
Rev Ops — Redwood Inference

Hi John — thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. Short version: we can materially reduce the migration surcharge with a conditional commercial structure. Details below.

Offer (finalized for commercial redline):
- Baseline migration surcharge (engineering & security): $112,500
- Conditional waiver: 60% waiver (effective surcharge to NovaMed = $45,000) if NovaMed signs a 12-month Private deployment + Dedicated capacity agreement (minimum 2.5M tokens/month) by 30 Apr 2026 and confirms Q4 rollout window.
- Alternative: 40% waiver (effective $67,500) if you sign a 6-month pilot conversion plan by 31 May 2026.
- Minimum guaranteed migration baseline in all cases: $30,000 (non-waivable) to cover security validation and KMS integration.
- Support tier: Enterprise SRE Tier — $18,000/mo plus multisite add-on $6,500/mo; includes 1-hour P1 response and monthly ops reviews. We will attach an SRE addendum enumerating responsibilities and escalation paths.
- Clawback: 90-day prorated clawback window if NovaMed terminates prior to conversion; legal will propose a standard prorated schedule in contract.

Attachments: I attached the redlineable term-sheet and the updated SOW. If this looks reasonable, Marissa will open the commercial redline and I can schedule a short legal sync with your contracts team.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call this week to walk through.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
